meta.disclaimer: openFDA data is not for clinical use.

indications_and_usage: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE KEYTRUDA is a programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1) blocking antibody indicated for treatment of unresectable or metastatic melanoma.
dosage_and_administration: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks.
warnings_and_cautions: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Immune-mediated adverse reactions can occur in any organ system.
adverse_reactions: 6 ADVERSE REACTIONS Most common (>=20%) are fatigue, musculoskeletal pain, rash, diarrhea, pyrexia, cough, decreased appetite.
pregnancy: 8.1 Pregnancy KEYTRUDA can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman.
pediatric_use: 8.4 Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness established in pediatric patients with melanoma, cHL, PMBCL, MCC.
geriatric_use: 8.5 Geriatric Use No overall differences in safety observed between elderly and younger patients.
